description: This file defines a PHP trait 'QuickLaunchServiceTrait' within the OrangeHRM Dashboard plugin. The trait provides a method to access the 'QuickLaunchService' via dependency injection, utilizing the 'ServiceContainerTrait'. It is part of the service layer, facilitating access to quick launch functionalities within the dashboard module.

methods.name: getQuickLaunchService
methods.description: Provides access to the QuickLaunchService instance via the dependency injection container.
